faq.question: Are Magic: The Gathering Secret Lair drops worth it?
faq.answer: It depends on the drop. Mana Value totals every card in each Secret Lair as singles using current Cardmarket and TCGplayer prices, so you can compare that total against the drop's retail price and decide whether buying the drop beats buying the cards individually.

faq.question: How is each Secret Lair's value calculated?
faq.answer: Each card in the drop is matched to its cheapest available single, then summed into a non-foil total and a foil total. You can switch between Cardmarket (EUR-based) and TCGplayer (USD-based) prices, market/trend vs. lowest listing, and any printing vs. Secret Lair-only printings.

faq.question: Where do the prices come from?
faq.answer: Prices come from Cardmarket and TCGplayer and are refreshed regularly. Cardmarket prices are in EUR and TCGplayer prices in USD; Mana Value converts them to your selected currency for display.

faq.question: What is the difference between the non-foil and foil totals?
faq.answer: The non-foil total sums the cheapest non-foil printing of each card; the foil total sums the cheapest foil printing. Secret Lair drops are often sold in both non-foil and foil editions, so each is priced separately.
